Name: Mela's Cat Dragons
Author: Dragondancer818
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=5]Update for 1.6 Online![/size][size=4]


[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][b][center][size=4]This Mod changes the five cat skins to different colors of Dragons: [/size][color=#ffd966][size=4]
[/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]**Turqouise**[/size][/color][color=#ffd966][size=4]
[/size][/color][color=#9900ff]**Purple**[/color][color=#ead1dc][size=4]
[/size][/color][color=#b4a7d6][size=4]**Lilac**[/size][/color][color=#ffd966][size=4]
[/size][/color][color=#3c78d8][size=4]**Blue**[/size][/color][color=#ffd966][size=4]
[/size][/color][color=#6aa84f][size=4]**Smaragd**[/size][/color][color=#ffd966][size=4]

[/size][/color][size=4]For correlation check the picture.[/size][color=#ffd966][size=4]
[/size][/color][size=4]
[/size][size=4][font=Georgia][b]They have beautiful smoke coming from their noses, when they sleep <3[/b]![/font][/size][color=#ffd966]
[/color][/center][/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]


My first Mod changes the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19162]dogs to Dragons[/url].
(https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19162).

Someone asked me, to make the cats, so here you go!

[b]

[/b][center][b]
[font=Georgia][size=3][b]-------------[/b][/size][/font] Thanks -------------
[/b][/center][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]When I installed EveriasArt's Mod[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4467/]"Everia's Dragons"[/url] I saw, that there is no assets for the babies, so I added them for a few colours (You can get the assets from me). Later I wanted to have that baby dragon as a dog, so I downloaded TheObscureCat's Mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15448]"Stardew Toothless"[/url] for cats as a guide to create these Mods.
Big Thanks to Everia for the inspiration and Obscure Cat for the guidance!!![/size][size=4]
[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3]
[center]
[b][font=Georgia][size=3][b]-------------[/b][/size][/font] Sounds [font=Georgia][size=3][b]-------------[/b][/size][/font][/b][/center]
To add sound, I installed[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14879] 'Cat Sounds Replacement'[/url]﻿ and patched my favourite dragon sounds into it. I also uploaded them separately, see files.[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17815]Toothless Sounds[/url] also works well with this mod!

[/size][/font]

Downloads.Description: This is just 3 Rwarrs and a Purr, that go along with my Dragons. You can implement them into another mod like Cat Sound Replacements or Toothless Sounds. Have fun with your Dragons!
